correctness.rationale: For the positive Dirichlet Laplacian L, Cauchy-Schwarz in L+tI gives the nodal bound. The explicit reflected Green kernel yields h_m(r)=2 sqrt(r)(1-r^(2m))/(1+r). Its derivative equation has exactly one root in (0,1); G_m+2tG_m′=0 forces the Green extremizer to have ||Dg||²=t||g||², hence the upper bound is attained, with all equality cases from Cauchy-Schwarz uniqueness. Pointwise strict monotonicity gives K_m increasing to 1. Writing a_m=-m log r_m reduces the critical equation to exp(2a)-1=4m coth(a/(2m)); a_m=log m-(log log m)/2+(log8)/2+o(1) and 8m²(1-K_m)=a_m²+a_m+o(1), proving the full three-term claim. Actual embedded Python checker was run with 1007 passing finite/symbolic corroborations; finite evidence is not the infinite proof.

The known mechanism and kernel are cited as prior. An equivalent historically unindexed formulation remains a residual bibliographic risk.
